root_cause.text: The command stream parsing loop in `ethosu_gem_cmdstream_copy_and_validate()` increments the index variable `i` a second time for 64-bit commands without re-checking the loop bound, allowing a heap out-of-bounds write when the second word is written past the DMA-allocated buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a bounds check (`if (i >= size / 4) return -EINVAL;`) after the `i++` for the second word. The CVE description details the exact scenario: when `i == size/4 - 1` and bit 14 is set, the first write is in bounds, but after incrementing `i` to `size/4`, the second write `bocmds[i] = cmds[1]` accesses `bocmds[size/4]`, which is four bytes past the end of the allocation.
